description: This source file defines the CachedCatalogViewModelService class, which implements caching for catalog-related data retrieval operations such as fetching brands, types, and catalog items. It enhances performance by using in-memory caching to avoid redundant data fetches.

classes.name: CachedCatalogViewModelService
classes.description: A service class implementing cached data retrieval for catalog views, providing methods to get brands, types, and catalog items with in-memory caching.

methods.name: GetBrands
methods.description: Retrieves a list of brand options, utilizing cache to improve performance.

methods.name: GetCatalogItems
methods.description: Retrieves catalog items with specified paging and filtering, using cache to optimize repeated access.

methods.name: GetTypes
methods.description: Retrieves a list of catalog types, with caching for efficiency.
